text: The set-quotient A/R (for a relation R: A → A → Prop) in HoTT can be constructed as:
choices: the image of the map [·]: A → A/R
the pushout A ∪_{A×A} A (one copy per related pair)
a higher inductive type with point constructor [·]: A → A/R and path constructor q: ∀x,y. R(x,y) → [x]=[y]
explanation: A/R as a HIT: point constructor [·]: A → A/R and path constructor q: R(x,y)→[x]=[y], plus the 0-truncation condition. The universal property: maps A/R → B (B a set) correspond to R-respecting functions A → B.
